Example Brain Foundation

Investigator Awards in Neural Development

The Example Brain Foundation supports bold, early-stage research into how nervous systems are built, with a particular interest in comparative and evolutionary approaches that move beyond traditional laboratory models and open new questions.

Award details

Awards provide up to $300,000 over three years ($100,000 per year), including indirect costs capped at 10%.

Eligibility

Applicants must hold a tenure-track faculty appointment at a US institution and be within six years of their first independent position. Institutions may submit only one nomination per institution.

Key dates

  • Pre-proposals due: January 15, 2027
  • Full proposals (by invitation): April 1, 2027
  • Awards announced: July 2027

Questions? Write to grants@examplebrain.org
